**[@fig-scatter-peak]** | **Latent dimension pairs reveal continuous dementia progression trajectory.** **A–D,** Two-dimensional kernel density contour plots illustrating [the distribution of participants]{.rev} across pairs of latent dimensions at EWAS threshold *P* < 1.0 × 10^−8^ (403 CpGs): VAE_5 versus VAE_6 (rank 1, **A**), VAE_2 versus VAE_5 (rank 2, **B**), UMAP_1 versus UMAP_5 (rank 1, **C**), and UMAP_1 versus UMAP_2 (rank 2, **D**). [Blue contours represent the stable normal reference group and orange contours the comparison group named above each facet; individual participants are shown as points.]{.rev} Each panel displays five facets corresponding to the transition groups: normal2mci, stable_mci, normal2incid, mci2incid, and prev_dementia. Dimension pairs are ranked by dementia progression score (DPS). **E–H,** Density-weighted contour center trajectory plots for the corresponding dimension pairs from panels **A–D**, with DPS values of 0.442 (**E**), 0.415 (**F**), 0.911 (**G**), and 0.834 (**H**). The star denotes the contour center of [the stable normal group]{.rev} (blue); colored points mark the contour centers for normal2mci (orange), stable_mci (green), normal2incid (red), mci2incid (purple), and prev_dementia (brown). Arrows connect sequential centroids along the [clinical progression ordering]{.rev}, delineating the epigenetic progression path from normal2mci through stable_mci, normal2incid, and mci2incid to prev_dementia.
